text_block_list.text: While passing through the busy area in front of the station—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...
Mommy... where are you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Did you get
separated from your mother?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright! We'll find it for sure,
so don't you worry!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Is anyone missing a little girl?!
Where is her mommy?!

"However, amidst all the people coming and going,
no one has stepped forward to claim it."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that's it♪
Excuse me, but let me hold you for just a second!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho~!
How's it looking? Can you see your mom?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! There she is!
Right by the karaoke sign!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that person in the white clothes~!
Ah, but they're heading further and further away!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew... I managed to find Mom, but the crowd was just incredible...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...And so, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll definitely bring Mom back!
Bono, back me up over the radio!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Contact them on the phone, right?♪
Understoo~d!

Making good use of her petite frame,
Biko Pegasus easily weaves through the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Big Sister, you're so fast!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, hellooo~! Mom's heading over towards the gyudon shop~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Just go straight ahead~
That person right there! The one with long black hair and white clothes~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! Biko-chan managed
to stop her mom~!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Yay! Mommy—!

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
You were truly a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Not at all, you're very welcome~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's great that you got to see your mom!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, big sisters!
Bye-bye!
The mother and the young girl walked away, smiling and waving their hands.
choice_data_list: You two were amazing out there.
You two were amazing out there, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Were you watching
our combo just now?
choice_data_list: The combination between the two of them was perfect.
You looked just like a hero.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "It's all thanks to you chasing after me, Biko-chan~."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's also thanks to Bono, who didn't miss sight of her mother!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Fufu, we make a great team, don't we!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Seriously!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm.
Watching you weave through the crowd was so cool, Biko-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You were like a hero calling the shots from HQ, Bono!
